title: Affiliate Manager Training & Tools with Dustin Howes
description: Meet Dustin Howes whom is the first person I think of when I think about affiliate marketing. Dustin has made a name for himself by hosting the Affiliate Nerd Out podcast, he runs Performance Marketing Manager which helps educate and train affiliate managers and he is also the co-founder of Affistash which is a tool for affiliate managers to help them prospect affiliates.
